title: Mitigating Regional Traffic Congestion via School Start Time Scheduling: A Bilevel Alternating Optimization Approach
summary: This paper addresses morning commute congestion caused by concentrated school-related trips in urban networks. We propose a bi-level optimization framework for regulating school start times in a multi-region urban network characterized by Macroscopic Fundamental Diagrams (MFDs), explicitly coupling system-level regulation with multi-class user-equilibrium-based departure-time choices.
